messages:
mira: quick postmortem follow-up: recurring pattern -> resolver failure -> immediate LB rotate -> TLS fallback mismatches. need owners/timelines.
noah: saw traces at 08:22 UTC, lots of 504s then bursts of DNS lookups. retry amplification obvious.
li: logs:
```
2026-05-02T08:22:11Z lb.edge: resolver_timeout host=svc.prod attempt=1
2026-05-02T08:22:11Z dns.client: response=SERVFAIL
2026-05-02T08:22:11Z lb.edge: rotate_host action=blacklist duration=2s
```
sam: propose actions:
- A1: resolver wrapper with 2 retries + exponential backoff (owner: li). Target: PR in 3d, canary 1 week.
- A2: enforce min DNS cache TTL = 30s and make configurable (owner: anya). Target: config change in 2d.
- A3: add TLS handshake circuit-breaker per-upstream (>5 failures in 60s -> mark degraded for 60s) (owner: noah). Target: PR in 7d.
- A4: metric + alert for rapid re-resolve rate + rotation spikes (owner: mira). Target: dashboard in 2d.
anya: I'll take A2. will coordinate with platform for low-latency customers.
li: taking A1. impl note: keep in-process in lb-agent, add unit tests; avoid touching system resolver.
olivia: A3: will review state machine and edge memory impact.
infra-bot: Created INC-4722: https://tracker.internal/INC-4722 - "edge: resolve-rotate-tls follow-ups" assigned to triage
mira: please update INC-4722 with PR links, test plans, and deploy times. I'll run a 1-week sync next Mon.
sam: adding an e2e test simulating resolver flaps and cert rotation (owner: sam). ETA: 1 week.
mira: thanks all. If any blocker, tag eng-oncall. :thumbsup:
